results.title: Malaysia to use Asean diplomatic channels to address trans-boundary haze
results.description: BANDAR SERI BEGAWAN: Malaysia will utilise Asean diplomatic channels to seek a solution to the transboundary haze affecting several areas in the region, says Datuk Seri Mohamad Hasan.

results.title: Nepal can no longer afford a new political adventure: Gagan
results.description: Kathmandu, Aug 21: Nepali Congress President Gagan Thapa has said Nepal cannot afford another political “adventure” at this point. Speaking at a book launch event titled “Loknayaks of Dolakha” in Kathmandu on Thursday, he said Nepal does not need another political “adventure” now.
